pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with predominantly straight edges and moderate pixel gradients at boundaries; varied spatial area with larger, more rectangular patches on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more irregular shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream pathways forming a topological graph with predominantly tri-radiate junction nodes; pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, narrowing slightly towards the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the visible mane line from the upper neck through the shoulder region.
